headline: KazMunayGas Outlines $37.6 Billion Hydrocarbon Investment Program
summary: Kazakhstan's state oil producer KazMunayGas announced investment plans worth 16.7 trillion tenge ($37.6 billion) to expand exploration, boost gas output, and modernize domestic refineries.
why: Kazakhstan is Central Asia's largest oil producer, and its state hydrocarbon capital programs drive Caspian region energy supply dynamics.

impacts.name: KazMunayGas
impacts.why: Unveiled $37.6B in planned capital deployment across refining, exploration, and natural gas infrastructure.
